candidate_relations.reason: Pigmented basal cell carcinoma of the nail unit is a keratinocytic malignancy, not fibroepithelial onychomatricoma.
Onychauxis describes thickening over the band, a manifestation rather than pigmented onychomatricoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: nail thickening as a sign of onychomatricoma

candidate_relations.reason: Onychomycosis is a fungal nail infection, not a fibroepithelial matrix tumor.
No melanocytic lesion was found and S100 was negative, so subungual melanoma is excluded.
Intracorneal hemorrhage can pigment the nail but is not the villous fibroepithelial tumor.
There was no keratinocyte atypia, so squamous cell carcinoma in situ is not supported.
Longitudinal melanonychia is the clinical pigment band, not the underlying onychomatricoma.
Immunostains showed no melanocytic proliferation, so melanocytic activation conflicts with pigmented onychomatricoma.
Squamous cell carcinoma is a different nail-unit tumor.
Nail-plate fibroma is a related fibrous tumor but lacks the cavitated fibroepithelial projections of onychomatricoma.
Onychaustral sign is not a recognized equivalent of pigmented onychomatricoma.

case_quality_flags: Histology of villous fibroepithelial nail-matrix projections without melanocytes is onychomatricoma; no candidate uses that diagnosis
